people-ops-bot: :tada: Heads up — new hire joining next week! Please welcome Ash Sinha, Senior Manager, Platform Operations. Start date: 2024-06-03.
Maya Patel: yay! big win. Ash will lead incident readiness for Dedicated and own cross-team runbooks.
Ash Sinha: thanks everyone  excited to join. happy to jump into the on-call rotation and get the runbooks into shape.
Priya Natarajan: quick hiring note: we'll open the Platform Ops IC backfill today. scorecard + interview plan dropping in #recruiting by EOD.
Diego Morales: @Ash Sinha can you do a quick sync Thu 10am PT to review the Dedicated capacity rota? also there's a customer capacity review on 2024-06-10; would love you to sit in.
Ash Sinha: Thu 10am PT works. I'll join the 6/10 review too.
Lizzy Mendoza: onboarding packet sent, added to org chart, benefits invite on the calendar. @Ash Sinha please confirm pronouns and preferred slack handle.
Ash Sinha: pronouns he/him; slack: @ash.sinha. timezone PDT.
Maya Patel: FYI checklist for Ash before start:
```
- transfer Grafana ownership for Dedicated dashboards
- add to Dedicated pager rota
- grant access to aws-prod-gamma and grafana-team org
- invite to weekly capacity and postmortem reviews
- assign initial docs edits in Confluence
```
Samira Khan: adding a note — we'll want Ash to prioritize the SLA runbook and the warm fallback plan first 2 weeks. high impact for customers.
Priya Natarajan: referral reminder: if anyone knows strong Platform Ops IC candidates, DM me. we aim to close the IC hire this quarter. :rocket:
Maya Patel: logistics: equipment will ship by 5/28, security training links included in the packet. welcome lunch scheduled on 6/05.
Ash Sinha: appreciate the warm welcome everyone. looking forward to meeting the team and getting started! :wave:
